pageDescription: Fellowship, meals, prayer, study, and even a sewing ministry—find your place in a small group.
whyParagraph1: Small groups are where real life happens. It's where we move beyond Sunday morning hellos to genuine friendship, mutual encouragement, and shared growth in Christ.
whyParagraph2: Our groups meet in homes throughout Palm Coast and St. Augustine, offering flexibility and a comfortable environment to connect.
